sky arts.title: Discovering: David Bowie
sky arts.desc: Leading music critics and DJs discuss the life, music, legacy and larger-than-life stage characters of the glam rock legend.

sky arts.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
sky arts.desc: The Flypaper: Lorna Charles and Alfred Burke star in this twisted tale. With a 12 year-old found dead and a killer perhaps on the loose, a young girl becomes paranoid. (S2, ep 10)

sky arts.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
sky arts.desc: The Orderly World of Mr Appleby: Robert Lang stars in this tale with a twist. A man married three times might be lucky for the fourth time when he meets a new interest. (S2, ep 11)

sky arts.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
sky arts.desc: The Foghorn: Lucia meets and falls for Allen Bliss at a party that is a celebration of her engagement to another man, John St. Rogers. To her dismay, Allen himself is married. (S3, ep 24)

sky arts.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
sky arts.desc: Flight to the East: A newsman taking a trip to Egypt describes his past connection with arms trafficking to a fellow passenger who knows part of his story is untrue. (S3, ep 25)

sky arts.title: The Sixties
sky arts.desc: 1968: A look at the year which saw the assassinations of Robert F Kennedy and Martin Luther King Jr, as well as the escalation of the Vietnam War and civil rights protests. (S1, ep 8)

sky arts.title: Discovering: Jodie Foster
sky arts.desc: From a child model to an Academy Award nominated performance in Taxi Driver, this is the story of Jodie Foster's life and breakthrough to Hollywood. (S13, ep 4)

sky arts.title: Landscape Artist Of The Year
sky arts.desc: Joan Bakewell and Frank Skinner welcome a new group of artists to Knaresborough, where they are challenged to paint the striking views of the historic viaduct. (4 of 9)

sky arts.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
sky arts.desc: Fat Chance: A pharmacist tries to elope with his lover, but his larger than life wife stands in his way. John Castle and Miriam Margolyes star in this tale with a twist. (S2, ep 12)

sky arts.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
sky arts.desc: Back For Christmas: A philandering physician with an obsession for orchids cultivates a deadly plot to see off his wife. Siân Phillips and Richard Johnson star. (S3, ep 1)

sky arts.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
sky arts.desc: A Tangled Web: A charming French maid elopes with a professional burglar, but his jealous accomplice has his own plans. (S1, ep 18)

sky arts.title: New: Portrait Artist Of The Year 2026
sky arts.desc: New. The artists paint broadcaster Rylan Clark, musician Alison Balsom or theatre director Jamie Lloyd. Who will advance? (S13, ep 5)

sky arts.title: Matisse: The Last Masterpiece
sky arts.desc: Matisse: The Last Masterpiece: An unlikely wartime bond inspires Henri Matisse to create his bold masterpiece, the Chapelle du Rosaire, where art and faith collide. (S1, ep 1)

sky arts.title: Classic Movies: Dead Of Night
sky arts.desc: Ian Nathan explores what makes a classic, going behind the scenes of iconic films to reveal the ingredients of cinematic greatness. (S6, ep 3)

sky cinema premiere.title: Hitpig!
sky cinema premiere.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

sky cinema premiere.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema premiere.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema premiere.title: Splitsville
sky cinema premiere.desc: When his wife asks for a divorce, a man runs to his friends for support, only to learn that the secret to their happiness is an open marriage.

sky cinema premiere.title: Reminders of Him
sky cinema premiere.desc: Released from prison, Kenna tries to reunite with her daughter, but her custodial grandparents refuse to let her see her. She soon finds unexpected compassion from a local bar owner as their secret romance gives Kenna hope for a second chance.

sky cinema action.title: Hummingbird
sky cinema action.desc: An alcoholic ex-soldier struggles to atone for his sins.

sky cinema action.title: The Fast and the Furious
sky cinema action.desc: An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of LA street racers while investigating a rash of truck robberies.

sky cinema action.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
sky cinema action.desc: To clear his criminal record a former LA cop must infiltrate the Miami street-racing scene to set up a drug baron. Burning rubber all over the city with his ex-con friend, he attempts to deliver the crook to the FBI without crashing and being blown to pieces in one of the many explosions.

sky cinema action.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
sky cinema action.desc: Street-racing sequel following an adrenaline-junkie automobile addict who narrowly avoids jail by agreeing to move in with his father in Tokyo. However, he soon discovers the thrill of the local underground drift racing scene and unwittingly becomes involved with the Yakuza.

sky cinema family.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
sky cinema family.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

sky cinema family.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Movie
sky cinema family.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for, ending up in the Big City.

sky cinema family.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
sky cinema family.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

sky cinema family.title: Super-Charlie
sky cinema family.desc: A young boy attempts to solve an ongoing series of crimes with the help of his super-powered baby brother.

sky cinema comedy.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
sky cinema comedy.desc: Knockabout comedy set in the sexist world of 1970s newscasting. Ron Burgundy, San Diego's top-rated anchorman, reigns supreme in the all-male world of television news, until the arrival of an ambitious female reporter upsets the status quo. When she steps in to present the programme in Ron's absence, an uncivil war breaks out in the newsroom.

sky cinema comedy.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
sky cinema comedy.desc: Ron Burgundy tries to stay classy when he and his team take New York and the nation's first 24-hour global cable news network by storm.

sky cinema comedy.title: Anaconda
sky cinema comedy.desc: Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favourite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down.

sky cinema comedy.title: White Chicks
sky cinema comedy.desc: Disgraced FBI agents Marcus and Kevin go to bizarre lengths to catch a devious millionaire. They disguise themselves as dumb white socialites Brittany and Tiffany Wilson, the heiresses to a hotel fortune who are under threat. Gross-out comedic farce from the makers of `Scary Movie'.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Assassin's Creed
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A descendant of the mysterious secret society known as the Assassins uses his newfound knowledge and physical skills to battle the power-hungry Templar Order.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Mad Max
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Green Lantern
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A test pilot is granted a mystical green ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers, as well as membership into an intergalactic squadron tasked with keeping peace within the universe. Based on DC Comics characters.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers
sky cinema thriller.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

sky cinema thriller.title: Civil War
sky cinema thriller.desc: In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Accountant
sky cinema thriller.desc: A mild mannered, socially weird government accountant moonlights as a highly trained, and deadly assassin.

sky cinema thriller.title: Snatch
sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

sky cinema greats.title: The Witches of Eastwick
sky cinema greats.desc: Three frustrated female divorcees living in a quiet town wish for the perfect man to enter their lives. When a mysterious, rich and charming stranger buys a mansion in the community, it looks like their prayers have been answered - but the man they appear to have summoned seems more than a little devilish. Based on John Updike's novel.

sky cinema greats.title: Hook
sky cinema greats.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

sky cinema greats.title: The Karate Kid
sky cinema greats.desc: A new kid at a school makes the mistake of dating the ex-girlfriend of the school bully, whose gang then make his life a misery. He then bumps into a handyman who also happens to be a karate master. The handyman teaches him martial arts and he eventually meets up with his tormentors at a tournament, but will they fight fair?

sky cinema drama.title: Air
sky cinema drama.desc: Sonny Vaccaro and Nike pursue basketball rookie Michael Jordan, creating a partnership that revolutionizes the world of sports and contemporary culture.

sky cinema drama.title: My Girl
sky cinema drama.desc: Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend.

sky cinema drama.title: Stand by Me
sky cinema drama.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from `The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

sky cinema drama.title: Wuthering Heights
sky cinema drama.desc: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.
